description: Port and enhance TenantService and DiscoveryService from main repo, integrate cache and checkpoints into BrainService. Create srv/tenant/tenant-service.cds and .js from main repo patterns. Create srv/discovery-service.cds and .js with cache integration. Enhance existing srv/brain-service.js with LangGraph tools for artifact queries and checkpoint saver. Add MTXS subscription callbacks. All services use tenant isolation.
steps: 1. Create srv/tenant/ directory. Copy srv/tenant/tenant-service.cds from main repo to worktree. Add actions: savePipoSystem(systemConfig) - save connection with validation; testConnection(systemId) - verify connectivity; triggerDiscovery(systemId) - start discovery job returning DiscoveryRun.

2. Create srv/tenant/tenant-service.js implementing handlers for TenantService: on savePipoSystem - validate inputs (URL format, port range, required fields), INSERT into PISystem with tenantId from cds.context.tenant, return saved record; on testConnection - get system, create PIPoSoapClient, test DIR and ESR, update status; on triggerDiscovery - create DiscoveryRun, emit DiscoveryRequested event via cds.queued().

3. Create srv/discovery-service.cds by adapting from main repo. Include PISystems, DiscoveryJobs, Artifacts projections. Add actions: startDiscovery, getDiscoveryProgress, cancelDiscovery. Add AssessmentRequested event definition.

4. Create srv/discovery-service.js by porting from main repo. Key changes: integrate artifactCacheService - call cacheService.set() after discovering each artifact; use idempotencyService.checkAndLock() before processing; preserve tenant context in async workers using cds.context.tenant; add SSE event emission for UI updates.

5. Enhance srv/brain-service.js: Import capCheckpointSaver. Add LangGraph tools: get_artifact(id) - fetch from cache via artifactCacheService.get(); search_artifacts(query) - semantic search via vectorStore; get_dependencies(artifactId) - query DependencyGraph entity; analyze_migration_path(artifactIds) - AI analysis. Use checkpoint saver in LangGraph graph construction. Wrap graph operations with saveOnError for fault tolerance.

6. Create srv/mtx/provisioning.js with MTXS subscription callbacks: module.exports = (service) => { service.on('UPDATE', 'tenant', async (req, next) => {...}); }. On subscribe: log tenant creation, optionally seed reference data. On unsubscribe: cleanup tenant-specific cache entries.
7. Port srv/utils/pipoSoapClient.js and srv/utils/destinationService.js from main repo if not present, or create stubs that log operations
acceptance_criteria: srv/tenant/tenant-service.cds and .js exist with savePipoSystem, testConnection, triggerDiscovery
srv/discovery-service.cds and .js exist with startDiscovery, cache integration
srv/brain-service.js has LangGraph tools: get_artifact, search_artifacts, get_dependencies
All services use cds.context.tenant for tenant isolation
verification: Grep for 'cds.context.tenant' in service files to verify tenant isolation
findings: All files created successfully. JS syntax checks passed. Tenant isolation implemented via cds.context.tenant in all service handlers. Terminal rendering issues prevented clean build output, but no compilation errors observed.
